scope: Close a visible in-app popup when the accessibility tree has no close-button node.

root_cause.finding: The model received screenshots and recognized the close X. The final AX trees contain only Application/Window/Other/Other, untruncated. The exposed action schema has no coordinate operation. No close-button tap was dispatched.

implementation.coordinates: Full screenshot normalized x/y in [0,1), mapped using runner /window/size points; never use AX root bounds.
implementation.binding: Only a screenshot attached to the latest observation in the matching foreground app/process and screen geometry can supply the point.
implementation.dispatch: One authenticated POST /tap through the existing on-device runner; action consumes its observation, unknown remains non-replayable.
implementation.verification_entry: Explicit -amber-phone-popup-close-inspection-once uses the existing prompt handoff/new conversation/model path for a fixed close-only task. No setting/scope override.

verification.red_tool: Actual iOS XCTest testScreenshotOnlyCloseButtonHasReachableAction failed once: old parser rejects tap_point. Assertion preserved in build/popup-close-20261011/red-assertion.log. Xcode diagnostic collection hung after test completion and was terminated; the failure is from the executed test, not inferred from compiler output.
verification.independent_source_review: passed; screenshot/provider path, schema, client, runner endpoint, state outcomes and existing ref behavior checked
verification.visual_layout: No layout changes; before and after physical-device screenshots inspected for the reported popup.
verification.device_popup_closure: passed: actual model screenshot -> one tap_point -> new screenshot confirms popup and dimming removed -> phone_stop
verification.independent_device_review: passed: reviewer viewed both PNGs, matched bytes to tool image outputs, checked exactly one matching-ID tap followed by new observation and stop

data_policy: Raw conversation and screenshots stay in ignored local build evidence; this document contains only relevant redacted metadata.

device_verification.observed_by_parent: Before image contains promotional popup and dimming. After image shows unobstructed homepage with no promotional popup or dimming. One tap_point dispatch; no purchasing, ordering or messaging tool actions.
device_verification.scope: Same physical iPhone, same target App/PID as the report; actual model selected normalized coordinates. No Mac-started runner.

limits: This closes the reported popup scenario; it does not establish that every application or gesture is reliable.
Coordinates can target visually identifiable controls without AX refs; text entry and swipes retain their existing element-reference contracts.
This task does not extend prior acceptance claims for cold process restoration or all Live Activity states.
